title: how apollo rewrote rules wall street 2026 09 08
text:
Follow on Apple or Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.

The private equity and credit firm elbowed aside big banks to amass $1 trln of assets. In this episode of The Big View, William D. Cohan, author of ‘Money to Burn’, and Peter Thal Larsen discuss how Apollo rose from the 1990s junk bond wreck and whether its new model will endure.
(The host is a Reuters Breakingviews columnist. The opinions expressed are his own.)
